title: Test fixtures of a component
description: The props a component's tests and the docs' playground render it with (components/<name>/<name>.fixtures.json). Not part of the spec: the spec is the contract, and the docs' examples are files in the component's examples/ folder.

examples.description: Renderable examples as JSON props. The docs and the parity check mount them in React, Vue and Svelte.

props.description: JSON props, named as in the spec. Props marked `model` are bound two-way.

width.description: Wrapper width in px for components that fill their container.

frameworks.description: false when the example needs rich children that props cannot express: no target renders it (the plain-HTML target that did is archived).

steps.description: A scenario: the example changes over time. The props above are the first frame (what parity and a paused page show); each step waits `after` ms from the previous one, then merges its `props` over the current ones. The validator checks that every prop exists and is not a `model` prop, that `after` is 0 or more, and that the steps add up to under 20 seconds.

after.description: Milliseconds since the previous step (or since mount, for the first).

props.description: Props merged over the current ones, named as in the spec.

worstCase.description: Worst-case data for the same component, in the shape of `examples`: long names, unbreakable strings, one-letter values, missing optional fields, huge counts, zero and one item, non-Latin text. Realistic values only. The workbench swaps to these with its worst-case toggle (break-ui).
